description: President Secretariat - Establishment of the President Task Force for Economic Revival and Poverty Alleviation
categorisation: This gazette contains both the names of specific individuals (e.g., Basil Rajapaksa, Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe) and detailed descriptions of their responsibilities and the purpose of the Task Force for Economic Revival and Poverty Alleviation. It outlines the specific economic and social development goals, portfolios, and areas of responsibility for the appointed members, making it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3) as it includes both "who" is appointed and "what" they are responsible for.
